preconditions.description: The number of computers n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of existing cables m is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in cables)
preconditions.description: Each cable connects two computers, both of which have indices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of cables in the final scheme p is at least the number of existing cables m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= n and 1 <= di <= n for ci, di in final_cables)
postconditions.description: Each cable in the final scheme connects two computers, both of which have indices between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((ci, di) in final_cables or (di, ci) in final_cables for ci, di in cables)
postconditions.description: Each existing cable is included in the final scheme in one of the two possible directions.

postconditions.expression: all(len(outgoing_cables[computer]) % 2 == 0 for computer in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The number of cables coming out of each computer is even, allowing them to be grouped into pairs.
